pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark brown regions with sharp edge gradients. Morphology ranges from quadrilateral to hexagonal forms on the mid-neck, becoming more jagged and elongated on the shoulder and flank regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-cream pathways forming a consistent mesh. Junction nodes typically feature tri-radial or quadri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform with slight tapering observed at convergence points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane exhibits a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated profile against the sky background. Individual hair tufts are densely packed, creating a fine, jagged 1D contour.
